iboxs31_imu_init.tooltip: Starts the onboard QMI8658 six-axis sensor (I2C 0x6B, falls back to 0x6A) and the QMC6309 compass (I2C 0x7C, falls back to 0x2C); ±2g and ±1024°/s by default. Put it in setup

iboxs31_imu_range.tooltip: A smaller range is finer but clips stronger motion; the scaling follows automatically

iboxs31_imu_read.tooltip: Lying still, acceleration Z ≈ ±1 g; pitch and roll come from the accelerometer and are rough while shaking. Reads within 10 ms share one sample

iboxs31_imu_ok.tooltip: Whether the latest reading succeeded; on failure the last good values are kept

iboxs31_imu_mag_read.tooltip: Heading 0–360° (hard-iron offsets removed, declination added; keep the board level); X/Y/Z are raw field counts. Reads within 10 ms share one sample

iboxs31_imu_mag_calibrate.tooltip: Hard-iron calibration: turn the board flat a few full circles meanwhile; the new offsets apply at the end. The program waits during calibration

iboxs31_imu_mag_declination.tooltip: Local magnetic declination, east positive and west negative; it is added to the heading to point at true north

iboxs31_imu_mag_set_offsets.message0: compass hard-iron offsets X %1 Y %2 Z %3
iboxs31_imu_mag_set_offsets.tooltip: Set offsets from an earlier calibration (for example read back from storage at boot) to skip calibrating every time

iboxs31_imu_mag_offset.tooltip: The offset in use; after calibrating, store it and set it back next boot with the offsets block

iboxs31_imu_mag_ok.tooltip: Whether the latest reading succeeded; on failure the last good values are kept
